load_camera_poses: load camera poses and metadata from a NeRF-style transforms.json file with frame subsampling
save_camera_poses: save camera poses, intrinsics, and timestamps to a JSON file in NeRF-style format
compute_rays: compute ray origins and directions from a camera matrix, field of view, and image resolution
segment_times_vectorized: distribute sequences across k workers using a greedy load-balancing algorithm based on duration
prepare_images: extract and sample frames from a video file or load pre-existing images from a directory
